claims.price_target: $88 break = short oil; $95+ on Hezbollah trigger

claims.crowd_belief: Markets pricing demand destruction (stagflation) over supply risk (Iran-Hormuz). ADP +29K confirms weakening labor. Consensus says war premium is unwinding.

claims.strategy: Long gold as stagflation hedge — weak ADP + weakening labor + rising inflation expectations = Fed trapped. Gold benefits from both geopolitical risk premium and inflation hedge demand.
claims.crowd_belief: Gold at $2,415 reflects elevated geopolitical risk. But stagflation confirmation (ADP +29K + 3rd month inflation expectations rise) is a new vector not yet priced.
claims.contradiction: The stagflation vector is new — markets were pricing rate hikes, not cuts. If NFP Friday confirms ADP weakness, gold rallies on rate cut repricing + inflation hedge demand compounding.

claims.strategy: Long duration bonds (TLT, ZN) — ADP +29K starts the clock on rate cut expectations. If NFP Friday confirms, aggressive curve steepening.
claims.crowd_belief: 2Y yields at year-highs pricing rate hikes. ADP +29K is the first crack in that thesis. Market consensus still pricing hikes.
claims.contradiction: ADP is noisy but directional trend (weakening labor + rising inflation expectations) is structurally bullish for bonds. If NFP confirms, rate hike expectations unwind violently.

claims.strategy: Long VIX as tail hedge — Ben-Gvir proposal + automatic Beirut strike trigger = Hezbollah rocket event could fire at any time with zero diplomatic warning.
claims.crowd_belief: VIX complacent despite multi-front escalation. Markets not pricing Hezbollah rocket trigger probability.
claims.contradiction: The automatic Beirut strike mechanism means escalation is now a binary trigger, not a decision. Any rogue faction in Lebanon can start the next escalation cycle. VIX is underpricing this tail risk.
